cards.name: Rona, Herald of Invasion // Rona, Tolarian Obliterator

Rona, Herald of Invasion // Rona, Tolari.text: 2-mana legendary looter that untaps on each legendary cast (R5, R8)

The World Tree.text: at six lands every land taps for any colour (R3); enters tapped

Crystal Quarry.text: {5}: WUBRG — a guaranteed Jodah cast from six lands (R3); colourless otherwise

Meeting of the Five.text: MV 8 for WUBRG, but only casts exactly-three-colour spells; count them first

Wizard's Staff.text: doubles Jodah the Unifier's cascade (a Wizard, equip {1}); narrow

Gogo, Master of Mimicry.text: copies the Unifier's cascade trigger X times; mana-hungry

Oracle of the Alpha.text: conjures the Power Nine: five Moxen are fixing, Black Lotus is a Jodah cast (R3)

Tazri, Beacon of Unity.text: party discount, little for this plan

Timeless Lotus.text: taps for exactly WUBRG every turn — one Jodah cast per turn from one card (R1, R3)

Ramos, Dragon Engine.text: MV 6 for WUBRG; a five-colour cast adds five counters; ten mana once a turn

Omnath, Locus of All.text: card per turn, plus mana from 3+-pip cards, which this pile is full of

Maelstrom Archangel.text: flying 5/5; combat damage casts a spell from hand free (R4)

Jodah, the Unifier.text: legendary cascade plus a legend anthem — the second cheat layer (R4, R5)

Invasion of Alara // Awaken the Maelstro.text: free cast of an MV ≤4 card plus one to hand; the back face is a five-mode bomb

Infinite Guideline Station.text: Robots per multicoloured permanent; station 12 is slow

Golos, Tireless Pilgrim.text: fetches any land; late, plays the top three free (R3, R4)

Door to Nothingness.text: The alternate win: WWUUBBRRGG from ten any-colour lands, Timeless Lotus plus five, Ramos, or anything under Chromatic Orrery.

Chromanticore.text: 4/4 with five keywords; bestow cannot use the alt cost (R2)

Leyline of the Guildpact.text: every land is every basic type — all lands tap for any colour (R3); free from the opening hand

Marshals' Pathcruiser.text: basic to hand, then a vehicle

Nissa, Leyline Tamer.text: MV 7 for WUBRG; landfall draws and puts a creature onto the battlefield (R1, R4)

Thanos, the Mad Titan.text: 3-mana deathtouch lifelink; power-up is a parity sweeper (hits ours too)

Bringer of the Green Dawn.text: carries its own WUBRG alt cost (R6); a 3/3 every upkeep

Leyline of Mutation.text: the commander's ability on an enchantment (R6); free from the opening hand

Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic.text: taps for any colour and gives every other legend that ability (R3, R5); the back face, The Prismatic Bridge, is a WUBRG upkeep cheat that puts a creature or walker onto the battlefield (R4)

Widespread Thieving.text: a Treasure per multicoloured spell (R3); pay WUBRG to play the hideaway card free

Najeela, the Blade-Blossom.text: WUBRG extra combats; the Warrior half is off-plan

Kenrith, the Returned King.text: legend with five activations, reanimation {4}{B} and draw {3}{U} among them

Anticausal Vestige.text: warp {4}: it is exiled at end step, so it LEAVES — draw, then put a permanent with MV ≤ lands from hand onto the battlefield (R4); recast later

Bane of Bala Ged.text: MV 7 for WUBRG (R1); each attack exiles two of their permanents

Herigast, Erupting Nullkite.text: MV 9 for WUBRG; cast trigger refills the hand; every creature gets emerge

Ulamog, the Defiler.text: MV 10 for WUBRG; cast trigger exiles half their library, then enters huge with annihilator (R1)

Emrakul, the World Anew.text: MV 12 for WUBRG; cast trigger steals every creature they have (R1). Leaving sacrifices our creatures: protect it

Wizard Class.text: 1-mana enchantment that draws two at level 2 (R8)

Goro-Goro and Satoru.text: Owner's note: {1}{R} haste lets Ulamog's annihilator, Emrakul's stolen board, Raph & Mikey, Narset and the equipment carriers attack the turn they arrive, and new creatures connecting make 5/5 Dragons. Three mana in a top-heavy deck.

Spelldrain Assassin.text: casualty for an instant or sorcery

Fire Lord Azula.text: copies spells cast while she attacks (instant speed only)

Nicol Bolas, the Ravager // Nicol Bolas,.text: 4-mana flier with discard; the walker side removes and reanimates (BRU legend)

Obeka, Splitter of Seconds.text: extra upkeeps replay upkeep cheats (Prismatic Bridge, Bringer of the Green Dawn) — spice

Saruman, the White Hand.text: amass equal to a noncreature spell's printed MV: a cheated big spell makes a big Army

Inalla, Archmage Ritualist.text: Wizard copies; Jodah, the Unifier and Rona are Wizards, but the payoff wants five

Glamorous Outlaw.text: MV 6 for WUBRG; can sit exiled as a UBR land fixer

Sauron, the Dark Lord.text: MV 6 7/6, ward that costs them a legend

Lord Xander, the Collector.text: MV 7 for WUBRG; discard half, mill half, and sacrifice half when it dies (R1)

Cruel Ultimatum.text: {U}{U}{B}{B}{B}{R}{R} becomes WUBRG — the alt cost turns an uncastable card into a 5-mana blowout (R1)

Nicol Bolas, God-Pharaoh.text: MV 7 walker for WUBRG; +2 casts their card free, −4 deals 7 (R1, R4)

Sauron, Lord of the Rings.text: MV 8 for WUBRG; the cast trigger amasses 5 and reanimates a creature (R1, R4)

Pensive Professor.text: every WUBRG cast spends 5, so it grows and draws (increment)

Jace, Multiverse Architect.text: +1 draw two; −3 puts a creature or walker onto the battlefield (R4)

Bringer of the Black Dawn.text: own WUBRG alt cost (R6); upkeep tutor to the top

Iridescent Tiger.text: when cast, adds WUBRG — cast it, then cast a Jodah spell with the refund (R3)

Karolina Dean, Runaway.text: Owner's note: the WUBRG can't cast from hand, but this deck spends a lot outside it — One with the Multiverse's top-of-library casts, recasting Jodah from the command zone, Golos ({2}WUBRG), Nico, Yue's waterbend, Widespread Thieving's WUBRG, half of Door to Nothingness.

Prismatic Omen.text: 2 mana: every land is every basic type, so all lands tap for any colour (R3)

Prismatic Undercurrents.text: basics to hand plus an extra land drop

Vona de Iedo, the Antifex.text: ETB destroys a nonland permanent (R7 clean)

Loot, Exuberant Explorer.text: extra land drop; puts a creature with MV ≤ lands onto the battlefield

Bard, King of Dale.text: MV 6 for WUBRG; doubles extra draws and tokens

Olivia, Crimson Bride.text: MV 6 for WUBRG; each attack reanimates a creature, kept while Olivia (a legendary Vampire) stays (R4)

The Key to the Vault.text: An equipped flier (Jodah is a 4/3 flier) connects most turns: look at that many cards, cast one free.

Jacob Hauken, Inspector // Hauken's Insi.text: looter now; transformed, casts a card from its exile free each turn (R4)

Yue, the Moon Spirit.text: Waterbend {5} is generic and creatures/artifacts help pay: a repeatable free noncreature cast that needs no colours.

Jin-Gitaxias // The Great Synthesis.text: draws on noncreature MV 3+; the Saga's chapter III casts any number of spells free (R4)

Omniscience.text: MV 10 for WUBRG, then every spell from hand is free (R1, R4)

Nico Minoru, Runaway.text: {2}{R}, discard: cast the top nonland card free, repeatable; pings on every non-hand cast (R4)

Improvisation Capstone.text: MV 7 for WUBRG; free casts from the top, and paradigm repeats it free every first main phase (R1, R4)

Fight Rigging.text: hideaway released by a power-7 creature (the Eldrazi qualify)

Omnipresence.text: MV 8 for WUBRG; free casts capped by creature count

Kaya the Inexorable.text: −3 exiles a nonland permanent (R7 clean); the emblem casts legends free

Neera, Wild Mage.text: once a turn, swap a cast for a free cast off the top (R4)

Djeru and Hazoret.text: attacks cast a legendary creature from the top six free (R4, R5)

Unexpected Results.text: Owner's note: about 62% of the library is nonland averaging MV 5+, so 4 mana usually casts a bomb free; a land goes onto the battlefield and the card returns to hand to try again. Free casts also trigger Kellan and Nico.

Kellan, the Kid.text: every non-hand cast (Unifier, Nico, Capstone, Golos) also casts a permanent from hand free (R4)

Tamiyo, Field Researcher.text: the −7 emblem is a long way off

Gandalf, Party Guest.text: free instants/sorceries, scaled by legendary Wizards

Commander Spock.text: ETB and attack cast the top card free if its MV ≤ differently named lands — a singleton manabase makes that high (R4)

Narset, Enlightened Master.text: MV 6 for WUBRG; each attack casts noncreature spells from the top four free

Buster Sword.text: On Jodah it is 7 damage: draw, then cast a spell of MV 7 or less free.

Cosmic Cube.text: each attack casts from the top six, capped by the biggest attacker's power — the Eldrazi make that 7+

Planetarium of Wan Shi Tong.text: MV 6 for WUBRG; scry casts the top card free once a turn

Lukka, Coppercoat Outcast.text: −2 turns a creature into a bigger one from the library (R4)

Akul the Unrepentant.text: Owner's note: the body is the draw — a 5/5 flying trampler for {B}{B}{R}{R} (or WUBRG) is the best carrier for Buster Sword and The Key to the Vault. The cheat is rarely live: three other creatures to sacrifice, few tokens, and putting a bomb in skips its cast trigger.

Nissa of Shadowed Boughs.text: Owner's note: starts at 4 loyalty; +1 and a land drop a turn reach −5 two turns after landing and can repeat every couple of turns, from hand or graveyard, for a creature with MV ≤ lands.

Raph & Mikey, Troublemakers.text: MV 7 for WUBRG; each attack puts a creature from the library onto the battlefield attacking

Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy.text: doubles rock and dork mana (Timeless Lotus makes six); {5}{G}{U} puts a non-Human creature onto the battlefield

Nissa, Steward of Elements.text: X walker, X = 0 under the alt cost (R2)

Rocco, Cabaretti Caterer.text: X = 0 under the alt cost (R2); fine cast normally

Aang, at the Crossroads // Aang, Destine.text: puts an MV ≤4 creature from the top five onto the battlefield

Stable Wormhole.text: An any-colour land every attack, and the deck has an attack package.

Chandra, Hope's Beacon.text: MV 6 for WUBRG; +2 adds two mana of any colours, −X is removal

Goldspan Dragon.text: Treasures make two mana of one colour (R3)

Great Divide Guide.text: 2 mana: every land and Ally taps for any colour (R3)

Sunbird's Invocation.text: Every spell cast from hand reveals cards equal to its PRINTED mana value and casts one free: Ulamog for WUBRG reveals ten.

Chromatic Orrery.text: Spend mana as though it were any colour: WUBRG and Door's WWUUBBRRGG payable with any mana; taps for five; draws per colour.

One with the Multiverse.text: MV 8 for WUBRG; play from the top of the library and cast one spell free each turn.

Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal.text: MV 7 for WUBRG; on entering casts a free spell from each library.

Leyline of Anticipation.text: CUT 2026-11-15 for Raff Capashen, which covers the legendary spells and is itself a legendary Wizard. Leyline still covers non-legendary spells (Omniscience, Cruel Ultimatum, the interaction) and can start in play.

Sublime Epiphany.text: MV 6 instant for WUBRG: counters a spell AND an ability, bounces, copies, draws.

Jeskai Revelation.text: MV 7 instant for WUBRG: bounce, 4 damage, two Monks, draw two, gain 4.

Cryptic Command.text: Counter plus bounce, tap-down or draw.

Hero's Downfall.text: Instant: destroy a creature or planeswalker.

Teferi, Time Raveler.text: Opponents cast only at sorcery speed, protecting the big turns; −3 bounces and draws.

Lithoform Engine.text: Copies a trigger (Unifier cascade, Ulamog's cast trigger) or a spell; bench.

Roaming Throne.text: Naming Wizard doubles Jodah, the Unifier's and Rona's triggers; bench.

Echoes of Eternity.text: Doubles the colourless Eldrazi's cast triggers and copies colourless spells; its {C} cost is payable as WUBRG; bench.

Bring to Light.text: Paid as WUBRG it converges five: tutor a MV 5 or less card and cast it free; bench.

Gale's Redirection.text: Exiles a spell, sometimes cast it ourselves; bench.

Fires of Invention.text: Caps us at two spells a turn on our turn only, which breaks the free-cast chains (a cheat card that fights the engine).

Etali, Primal Storm.text: Attacks cast the top card of each library free; owned alternative to Primal Conqueror.

Warp Speed.text: 3-mana fixer and tempo card: lands enter untapped, so the 11 taplands, the shocklands without paying life, Stable Wormhole's and Artificial Anomaly's Planets and Golos's fetched land all come in ready; the enters trigger finds a basic. Strange new worlds draws two for {7}{U}{U} minus each differently named land (37 names in a singleton manabase). Measured ceiling: tapped lands cost 3.1 points of on-curve chance per card, recovered only while it is out.

Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain.text: Draws on every historic spell (artifact, legendary, Saga): 39 of the deck's 63 nonland cards are historic, so most casts — free casts included — draw a card.

Plaza of Heroes.text: Owned land: any colour for a legendary spell (most of the bombs are legends, and WUBRG alt casts count), any colour among legendary permanents, and {3} exile: hexproof and indestructible for Jodah. Replaces a tapland or one of the unowned rares.

Raff Capashen, Ship's Mage.text: IN 2026-11-15 for Leyline of Anticipation (owner's call): a legendary Wizard flash flier that gives every historic spell flash — most of the bombs are legends, and it feeds Jodah, the Unifier and Wizard's Staff-style Wizard synergies.

Thran Temporal Gateway.text: {4},{T}: put a historic permanent from hand onto the battlefield at any time, no cast needed — but a put-into-play skips cast triggers (Ulamog, Emrakul, Sauron), so it suits ETB legends (Etali, Lord Xander, Nissa).

Kethis, the Hidden Hand.text: Legendary spells cost {1} less (helps the hard-cast legends), and exiling two legends from the graveyard lets the rest be replayed this turn.

Otawara, Soaring City.text: Untapped legendary land; channel bounces an artifact, creature, enchantment or walker at instant speed for {3}{U} minus one per legendary creature (25 here). One colour only — a swap for a tapland, weighed against losing colours.

Takenuma, Abandoned Mire.text: Untapped legendary land; channel mills three and regrows a creature or walker, cheaper per legendary creature.

Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire.text: Untapped legendary land; channel deals 4 to an attacker or blocker, cheaper per legendary creature.

Mirror Box.text: Turns off the legend rule (Sublime Epiphany copies of legends) and pumps legends; narrow.

Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle.text: Reanimates MV 3 or less creatures on historic casts; the deck has few worth returning.

Replicator.text: {2},{T}: a tapped copy of a token you control. The useful targets here are Stable Wormhole's any-colour Planets (an extra land a turn) and Treasures from Widespread Thieving or Goldspan Dragon (two mana each under Goldspan). Only ~4 cards make tokens, so it idles without them.

Doubling Season.text: Owned. Planeswalkers enter with double loyalty: Nicol Bolas, God-Pharaoh at 14 can use −12 (exile every nonland permanent they control) the turn it lands; Kaya at 10 takes the −7 emblem (a free legendary cast every upkeep) at once; Lukka, Jace and Teferi go straight to their big abilities. Also doubles Planets, Treasures, Sauron's amass and Ramos's counters.

Vorinclex, Monstrous Raider.text: MV 6 for WUBRG: the loyalty-doubling half of Doubling Season on a 6/6 trample haste body (and halves the opponent's counters). Second copy of the effect.
